Standard: The air vehicle is designed with margin to withstand design ultimate loads without rupture or collapsing failures. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Verify the ASIP Master Plan or RSIP Master Plan, as specified in MIL-STD-1530 or MIL- STD-3063, respectively, documents the analysis and test verification methods required to certify the design for failure or collapse; that structural certification tasks are updated for modifications or changes to the air vehicle following initial AW certification basis; and all artifacts are developed IAW applicable sections of MIL-STD-1530 or MIL-STD-3063.
(2) Verify detailed structural design criteria for failure or collapse, as specified in MIL-STD- 1530 or MIL-STD-3063, documents the requirements to achieve structural integrity.
(3) Verify test plans are scoped to measure all internal load paths and demonstrate the strength design envelope. Analysis.
  (1) Verify strength analysis models are updated with ground tests, and analyses predictions are compliant with the structural design criteria. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Verify development tests substantiate: a. Material allowables. b. Material processing. c. Strength capability of joining methods.
    (2) Ground test: Verify the as-completed full-scale ground tests support the initial flight envelope IAW EZ-SB-22-01. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
  (2) Verify strength analysis models are based on flight test correlated loads, static test correlated internal loads, and the current air vehicle configuration, and analysis predictions are compliant with the structural design criteria and incorporated into the final strength summary and operating restrictions. Test.
  (3) Ground test: Verify the full-scale ground test substantiates the models used for strength analysis predictions and demonstrates the air vehicle can withstand design ultimate loads without failure or collapse.
